GUNASEKAR GOPAL

Senior Business Analyst | Investment Management & Capital Markets

(+91) 8754603411  |  gunasekargopal147@gmail.com  |  linkedin.com/in/gunasekar-gopal  |  Indian National

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience across Collateral Management, Treasury Operations, Trade Management, and Capital Markets transformation in tier-1 investment banks. Proven expertise in business analysis, functional specifications, UAT delivery, data analysis, and SQL-driven reconciliation across Agile and Waterfall frameworks. Strong domain knowledge spanning Repo, Securities Lending, liquidity management, regulatory reporting (CSDR/CASS/ EMIR), and Aladdin/Broadridge implementations — with hands-on experience in Power BI, Alteryx, and SQL for data analysis and automation.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Consultant — Deloitte USI	Nov 2024 – May 2026

L&G Alpha Implementation (Jul 2025 – May 2026)

Led end-to-end delivery across 18+ work streams spanning DiTL, Production Parallel, and Hypercare phases through to successful go-live.

Acted as primary liaison between client stakeholders, operations, and technology teams, maintaining alignment throughout delivery.

Governed RAID logs, risk registers, and issue trackers, ensuring timely resolution of critical blockers ahead of production deployment.

Prepared and presented executive MI reports and governance packs to senior management throughout the programme lifecycle.

Facilitated project workshops, entry criteria reviews, and go-live readiness checks across delivery work streams.

FT OMS & Middle Office — Aladdin Implementation (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025)

Produced BRDs and functional specifications, defining scope and data requirements for Aladdin configuration and testing.

Conducted current and future state process analysis, identifying gaps and recommending solutions aligned to business strategy.

Facilitated client-facing workshops to elicit requirements, map data flows, and support UAT coordination and production readiness.

Cross Assets Collateral & Risk Operations Senior Analyst — Société Générale GSC	Oct 2021 – Nov 2024

Treasury & Cash Management

Elicited and documented business requirements for a treasury funding and cash flow forecasting tool, translating operational needs into functional specifications for development teams.

Acted as BA for the design and build of a liquidity projection tool, defining data inputs, forecasting logic, and validation rules to support daily funding decisions.

Analysed daily liquidity positions across €15Bn and $9Bn Agency clearing portfolios, identifying funding gaps and providing data-driven insights to treasury stakeholders.

Defined business requirements and acceptance criteria for CCP margining workflows across 30+ CCP-facing and 100+ client-facing accounts, supporting settlement monitoring across LCH, Eurex, ICE Clear, and Nasdaq.

Mapped and documented end-to-end cash management processes across 22 currencies and 30+ bank accounts, identifying process gaps and driving reconciliation improvements.

Supported CASS settlement operations of £2.4Bn daily, producing functional documentation and controls to ensure regulatory-compliant money market and loan/borrow processing.

Data Analysis, Reconciliation & Automation

Executed data extraction and reconciliation across multiple systems using SQL, ensuring 95%+ data quality for regulatory reporting.

Supported SFTR regulatory reporting — ensuring trade-level data accuracy, lineage, and timely submission.

Drove automation of liquidity monitoring and management reporting processes in collaboration with business and technology teams, reducing manual effort by 40% across €9Bn and $3Bn clearing portfolios.

Streamlined data transformation and reconciliation workflows, accelerating analysis and reducing manual processing time.

System Implementation & Functional Consulting

Led Broadridge Message Automation implementation — scope definition, data mapping, UAT delivery across a €20Bn Collateral Optimisation tool.

Gathered client requirements and produced functional specifications; led data mapping workshops to the Broadridge target model.

Managed RTB and CTB activities simultaneously; prepared weekly KPIs, issue roadmaps, and handled audit queries.

Trained new joiners and delivered product knowledge transfer sessions to clients and internal teams.

Collateral and Repo Management Administrator — BNP Paribas GSO	Jul 2019 – Oct 2021

Supported front-to-back Repo and Securities Lending operations — settlement, reconciliation, and exception management across collateral platforms.

Validated SWIFT MT5xx connectivity between legacy systems and Aladdin during implementation and migration activities.

Resolved 50+ cash and 20+ stock breaks daily via IntelliMatch; administered Nostro reconciliation aligned to CSDR requirements.

Executed end-user UAT across collateral and settlement systems; coordinated SSI setup and account onboarding per client requirements.

Collateral Management Senior Financial Analyst — State Street	Mar 2017 – Jul 2019

Managed collateral substitutions, margining, and fund closings within T+0 and T+1 SLA timelines, maintaining operational performance.

Delivered accurate end-of-day collateral and settlement reporting to clients, ensuring transparency and operational control.

Resolved settlement fails, data breaks, and unmatched trades; led operational migration to HCL Coimbatore through structured knowledge transition.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis & BRD Creation | Data Analysis & SQL Reconciliation | Treasury & Cash Management | Liquidity Management | Collateral Management | Repo & Securities Lending | Functional & Data Specifications | UAT / SIT / Regression Delivery | Regulatory Reporting (SFTR / CSDR / CASS) | Aladdin & Broadridge Implementation | PMO Governance & RAID Management | Process Automation | Stakeholder Management | Agile & Waterfall Delivery |

TOOLS & APPLICATIONS

SQL | Microsoft Power BI | Alteryx | Jira | Smartsheet | Confluence | MS Project | SharePoint | Excel (Advanced) | Broadridge | Aladdin | Bloomberg | IntelliMatch | AcadiaSoft | Colline | TriResolve |

CERTIFICATIONS

NISM — Securities Operations and Risk Management (Series VII)

Agile Project Management

Microsoft Power BI

Data Visualization in Excel

Alteryx — In Progress

HONOURS & AWARDS

Spot Award — identified an incorrect €1.5Bn payment in risk and compliance.

Ace of Initiative Award — automated reports, reducing manual workload by 0.5 FTE.

Best Performer Award — OND and AMJ quarters.

Outstanding Performance Award — functional validation in a critical delivery programme.

COMPETITIONS & RECOGNITION

Secured first place in the competition on MT SWIFT message types and collateral management concepts.

Won the Best Team Award in the Settlements and Dispute Resolution Competition.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce — Bharathiyar University	Jun 2013 – Apr 2016

Business Administration & Law | Accounting & Taxation | Finance | Banking & Insurance

Thesis: A Study on Investment Patterns of Investors in Shares

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience across Collateral Management, Treasury Operations, Trade Management, and Capital Markets transformation in tier-1 investment banks. Proven expertise in business analysis, functional specifications, UAT delivery, data analysis, and SQL-driven reconciliation across Agile and Waterfall frameworks. Strong domain knowledge spanning Repo, Securities Lending, liquidity management, regulatory reporting (CSDR/CASS/ EMIR), and Aladdin/Broadridge implementations — with hands-on experience in Power BI, Alteryx, and SQL for data analysis and automation.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Consultant — Deloitte USI	Nov 2024 – May 2026
L&G Alpha Implementation (Jul 2025 – May 2026)
Led end-to-end delivery across 18+ work streams spanning DiTL, Production Parallel, and Hypercare phases through to successful go-live.
Acted as primary liaison between client stakeholders, operations, and technology teams, maintaining alignment throughout delivery.
Governed RAID logs, risk registers, and issue trackers, ensuring timely resolution of critical blockers ahead of production deployment.
Prepared and presented executive MI reports and governance packs to senior management throughout the programme lifecycle.
Facilitated project workshops, entry criteria reviews, and go-live readiness checks across delivery work streams.
FT OMS & Middle Office — Aladdin Implementation (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025)
Produced BRDs and functional specifications, defining scope and data requirements for Aladdin configuration and testing.
Conducted current and future state process analysis, identifying gaps and recommending solutions aligned to business strategy.
Facilitated client-facing workshops to elicit requirements, map data flows, and support UAT coordination and production readiness.
Cross Assets Collateral & Risk Operations Senior Analyst — Société Générale GSC	Oct 2021 – Nov 2024
Treasury & Cash Management
Elicited and documented business requirements for a treasury funding and cash flow forecasting tool, translating operational needs into functional specifications for development teams.
Acted as BA for the design and build of a liquidity projection tool, defining data inputs, forecasting logic, and validation rules to support daily funding decisions.
Analysed daily liquidity positions across €15Bn and $9Bn Agency clearing portfolios, identifying funding gaps and providing data-driven insights to treasury stakeholders.
Defined business requirements and acceptance criteria for CCP margining workflows across 30+ CCP-facing and 100+ client-facing accounts, supporting settlement monitoring across LCH, Eurex, ICE Clear, and Nasdaq.
Mapped and documented end-to-end cash management processes across 22 currencies and 30+ bank accounts, identifying process gaps and driving reconciliation improvements.
Supported CASS settlement operations of £2.4Bn daily, producing functional documentation and controls to ensure regulatory-compliant money market and loan/borrow processing.
Data Analysis, Reconciliation & Automation
Executed data extraction and reconciliation across multiple systems using SQL, ensuring 95%+ data quality for regulatory reporting.
Supported SFTR regulatory reporting — ensuring trade-level data accuracy, lineage, and timely submission.
Drove automation of liquidity monitoring and management reporting processes in collaboration with business and technology teams, reducing manual effort by 40% across €9Bn and $3Bn clearing portfolios.
Streamlined data transformation and reconciliation workflows, accelerating analysis and reducing manual processing time.
System Implementation & Functional Consulting
Led Broadridge Message Automation implementation — scope definition, data mapping, UAT delivery across a €20Bn Collateral Optimisation tool.
Gathered client requirements and produced functional specifications; led data mapping workshops to the Broadridge target model.
Managed RTB and CTB activities simultaneously; prepared weekly KPIs, issue roadmaps, and handled audit queries.
Trained new joiners and delivered product knowledge transfer sessions to clients and internal teams.
Collateral and Repo Management Administrator — BNP Paribas GSO	Jul 2019 – Oct 2021
Supported front-to-back Repo and Securities Lending operations — settlement, reconciliation, and exception management across collateral platforms.
Validated SWIFT MT5xx connectivity between legacy systems and Aladdin during implementation and migration activities.
Resolved 50+ cash and 20+ stock breaks daily via IntelliMatch; administered Nostro reconciliation aligned to CSDR requirements.
Executed end-user UAT across collateral and settlement systems; coordinated SSI setup and account onboarding per client requirements.
Collateral Management Senior Financial Analyst — State Street	Mar 2017 – Jul 2019
Managed collateral substitutions, margining, and fund closings within T+0 and T+1 SLA timelines, maintaining operational performance.
Delivered accurate end-of-day collateral and settlement reporting to clients, ensuring transparency and operational control.
Resolved settlement fails, data breaks, and unmatched trades; led operational migration to HCL Coimbatore through structured knowledge transition.
